name: concept-lab
description: Builds one page that teaches one concept, any field: an interactive page the user drives, or a watch-only animation. Phone-first, minimal, dark. Computed mode runs the real model live; authored mode covers concepts with no model; watch mode unfolds the concept scene by scene. Intent-lock gated; clinical facts from sourced reports only; each page is published as its own artifact. Replaces ml-concept-lab and concept-animation.
